Relay local development build — licensing/source availability

Original source explicitly identified in LICENSING.md is under MPL-2.0.
MPL-2.0.txt contains the unmodified license. Third-party code keeps its
own terms; the main app includes ZXING-LICENSE.txt and ZXING-NOTICE.txt.

This is a local development build, not an official binary release.
Branding policy 1.0 is adopted effective 2026-11-18; see BRANDING.md.
This does not establish third-party clearance. Before distributing
an APK, provide the applicable covered source and an accessible source
location corresponding to that exact build, and verify all asset terms
and third-party notices. This notice does not claim those distribution
requirements have already been met.
